weights: The 23 files of the revision, fetched from huggingface.co into /dev/shm on the node and each checked against the sha256 (LFS files) or git blob hash the Hub API gives for it.
installation: The SGLang 0.5.23 venv of the earlier runs (sglang-kernel 0.4.10, torch 2.14.1+cu130, triton 3.8.0, flashinfer-python 0.7.2, nvidia-cutlass-dsl 4.8.0), run as a vf venv.
method: Two sessions on the same GPU, each server started as in section 4 of docs/guides/sglang.md (session 1 with empty caches, session 2 with the caches of session 1), then the guide's chat request and three passes of the unchanged docs/guides/benchmarks/sglang.py: one warm-up and three salted prompts at temperature zero and batch size one each. The first pass is the guide's protocol; the next two measure the run-to-run spread on the same server. Forward GPU timers count 227 input tokens, then 63 decode steps for 64 output tokens.
